<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="r7fu5DF0a_MUKbhIppPO"> <mxGraphModel dx="4120" dy="1893" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph LR
 %% --- STYLES & SHAPES ---
 classDef source fill:#f9f2ec,stroke:#e69f00,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef stg fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#d35400,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef tmp fill:#e0f7fa,stroke:#00838f,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef tgt fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef marts fill:#eceff1,stroke:#455a64,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 
 %% Quality Gate Shapes
 classDef decision fill:#ffffff,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef fail_action fill:#ff8a80,stroke:#b71c1c,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef quarantine_action fill:#ffcdd2,stroke:#c62828,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef alert_action fill:#fff9c4,stroke:#fbc02d,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;
 classDef quarantine_tbl fill:#ffebee,stroke:#c62828,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray: 5 5,color:#000;

 %% --- 1. SOURCES ---
 subgraph Sources [\"1. Source Files (Landing Zone)\"]
 S1[\"pos_sales_YYYYMMDD.csv<br/>Frequency: Daily<br/>Feeds: TGT_FCT_SALES\"]
 S2[\"inventory_snapshot_YYYYMMDD.csv<br/>Frequency: Daily<br/>Feeds: TGT_FCT_INVENTORY\"]
 S3[\"item_master_YYYYMMDD.csv<br/>Frequency: Daily<br/>Feeds: TGT_DIM_ITEM, TGT_DIM_SUBCLASS\"]
 S4[\"store_master_YYYYMMDD.csv<br/>Frequency: Weekly<br/>Feeds: TGT_DIM_LOCN, TGT_DIM_DISTRICT\"]
 S5[\".COMPLETE<br/>Sentinel Signal\"]
 end

 %% --- 2. STAGING (STG) ---
 subgraph STG [\"2. Staging Layer (STG - Raw / As-Landed)\"]
 STG1[(\"STG_POS_SALES<br/>Format: Table/CSV | Partition: None<br/>Load: Full\")]
 STG2[(\"STG_INVENTORY<br/>Format: Table/CSV | Partition: None<br/>Load: Full\")]
 STG3[(\"STG_ITEM_MASTER<br/>Format: Table/CSV | Partition: None<br/>Load: Full\")]
 STG4[(\"STG_STORE_MASTER<br/>Format: Table/CSV | Partition: None<br/>Load: Full\")]
 end

 %% --- 3. TRANSFORMED (TMP) ---
 subgraph TMP [\"3. Transformed Layer (TMP - Clean & Conformed)\"]
 TMP1[(\"TMP_POS_SALES<br/>Format: Table | Partition: Date<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 TMP2[(\"TMP_INVENTORY<br/>Format: Table | Partition: Date<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 TMP3[(\"TMP_ITEM_MASTER<br/>Format: Table | Partition: None<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 TMP4[(\"TMP_STORE_MASTER<br/>Format: Table | Partition: None<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 
 TMP_Q1[(\"TMP_QUARANTINE<br/>Rejected Rows + Reason Code<br/>Load: Append\")]
 end

 %% --- QUALITY GATE NODES & ACTIONS ---
 %% Shared Schema Gate
 QG1{\"Q1: Schema Test<br/>File exists & schema matches?\"}
 Fail1([\"FAIL: Stop DAG<br/>File missing / bad schema\"])

 %% Item Master Path Gates (Q2-Q4)
 QG_ITEM_1{\"Q2-ITEM: Null PK<br/>item_id IS NULL?\"}
 QG_ITEM_2{\"Q3-ITEM: Duplicate PK<br/>item_id duplicated?\"}
 QG_ITEM_3{\"Q4-ITEM: SCD2 Validity<br/>date overlap detected?\"}
 Quar_Item[/\"QUARANTINE: NULL or DUP PK<br/>Action: Route Row\"/]
 Alert_Item>\Alert: Notify Team<br/>SCD2 Overlap/]

 %% Store Master Path Gates (Q2-Q4)
 QG_STORE_1{\"Q2-STORE: Null PK<br/>location_id IS NULL?\"}
 QG_STORE_2{\"Q3-STORE: Duplicate PK<br/>location_id duplicated?\"}
 QG_STORE_3{\"Q4-STORE: SCD2 Validity<br/>date overlap detected?\"}
 Quar_Store[/\"QUARANTINE: NULL or DUP PK<br/>Action: Route Row\"/]

 %% Subclass Dim Path Gates (derived from TMP_ITEM_MASTER)
 QG_SUB_1{\"Q2-SUB: Null PK<br/>subclass_id IS NULL?\"}
 QG_SUB_2{\"Q3-SUB: Duplicate PK<br/>subclass_id duplicated?\"}
 QG_SUB_3{\"Q4-SUB: SCD2 Validity<br/>date overlap detected?\"}
 Quar_Sub[/\"QUARANTINE: NULL or DUP PK<br/>Action: Route Row\"/]

 %% District Dim Path Gates (derived from TMP_STORE_MASTER)
 QG_DIST_1{\"Q2-DIST: Null PK<br/>district_id IS NULL?\"}
 QG_DIST_2{\"Q3-DIST: Duplicate PK<br/>district_id duplicated?\"}
 QG_DIST_3{\"Q4-DIST: SCD2 Validity<br/>date overlap detected?\"}
 Quar_Dist[/\"QUARANTINE: NULL or DUP PK<br/>Action: Route Row\"/]

 %% Inventory Path Gates (Q2-Q4)
 QG_INV_1{\"Q2-INV: Null FK<br/>item/loc ID IS NULL?\"}
 QG_INV_2{\"Q3-INV: Logic Check<br/>on_hand_qty < 0?\"}
 QG_INV_3{\"Q4-INV: Duplicate Check<br/>item+loc+date duplicated?\"}
 Quar_Inv[/\"QUARANTINE: Null FK / Neg Qty / Dup<br/>Action: Route Row\"/]

 %% POS Sales Path Gates (Q2-Q5)
 QG_POS_1{\"Q2-POS: Null FK<br/>item/loc ID IS NULL?\"}
 QG_POS_2{\"Q3-POS: Logic Check<br/>sales_qty < 0?\"}
 QG_POS_3{\"Q4-POS: Duplicate Check<br/>trans_id+line duplicated?\"}
 QG_POS_4{\"Q5-POS: Referential Integrity<br/>item_id IN TMP_ITEM_MASTER?\"}
 Quar_POS[/\"QUARANTINE: Null FK / Neg Qty / Dup / Orphan<br/>Action: Route Row\"/]

 %% Reconciliation Gate
 QG6{\"Q6: Reconciliation<br/>TGT Net Sales == STG Net Sales?\"}
 Fail2([\"FAIL: Stop DAG<br/>Reconciliation mismatch\"])

 %% --- 4. TARGET (TGT) ---
 subgraph TGT [\"4. Target Layer (TGT - Dimensional Model)\"]
 TGT1[(\"TGT_DIM_ITEM<br/>Type: SCD2 | Load: Merge<br/>Business Key: item_id\")]
 TGT2[(\"TGT_DIM_LOCN<br/>Type: SCD2 | Load: Merge<br/>Business Key: location_id\")]
 TGT3[(\"TGT_DIM_DAY<br/>Type: SCD1 | Load: Seed<br/>Seeded Calendar\")]
 TGT4[(\"TGT_DIM_CUSTOMER<br/>Type: SCD1 | Load: Merge\")]
 TGT8[(\"TGT_DIM_SUBCLASS<br/>Type: SCD2 | Load: Merge<br/>Business Key: subclass_id<br/>Auxiliary reference dim\")]
 TGT9[(\"TGT_DIM_DISTRICT<br/>Type: SCD2 | Load: Merge<br/>Business Key: district_id<br/>Auxiliary reference dim\")]
 TGT5[(\"TGT_FCT_SALES<br/>Type: Transaction<br/>Grain: Item, Loc, Day, Line<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 TGT6[(\"TGT_FCT_INVENTORY<br/>Type: Positional<br/>Effective From/To Dates<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 TGT7[(\"TGT_FCT_PRICE<br/>Type: Positional<br/>Price per Item/Loc/Day<br/>Load: Delta/Merge\")]
 end

 %% --- 5. MARTS ---
 subgraph Marts [\"5. Marts & Consumers\"]
 M1[\"TGT_RPT_AGGREGATES<br/>(BI Dashboards, Finance)\"]
 end


 %% ============================================================
 %% CONNECTIONS & BRANCHING
 %% ============================================================

 %% 1. Sources to STG (Schema Gate)
 S1 & S2 & S3 & S4 -->|COPY INTO| QG1
 S5 -.->|Wait & Timeout| QG1
 QG1 -->|Pass| STG1 & STG2 & STG3 & STG4
 QG1 -.->|Fail| Fail1

 %% 2. STG to TMP: ITEM MASTER PATH
 STG3 --> QG_ITEM_1
 QG_ITEM_1 -->|Pass| QG_ITEM_2
 QG_ITEM_1 -.->|Fail| Quar_Item
 
 QG_ITEM_2 -->|Pass| QG_ITEM_3
 QG_ITEM_2 -.->|Fail| Quar_Item
 
 QG_ITEM_3 -->|Pass| TMP3
 QG_ITEM_3 -.->|Fail| Alert_Item

 %% 3. STG to TMP: STORE MASTER PATH
 STG4 --> QG_STORE_1
 QG_STORE_1 -->|Pass| QG_STORE_2
 QG_STORE_1 -.->|Fail| Quar_Store
 
 QG_STORE_2 -->|Pass| QG_STORE_3
 QG_STORE_2 -.->|Fail| Quar_Store
 
 QG_STORE_3 -->|Pass| TMP4
 QG_STORE_3 -.->|Fail| Alert_Item

 %% 4. STG to TMP: INVENTORY PATH
 STG2 --> QG_INV_1
 QG_INV_1 -->|Pass| QG_INV_2
 QG_INV_1 -.->|Fail| Quar_Inv
 
 QG_INV_2 -->|Pass| QG_INV_3
 QG_INV_2 -.->|Fail| Quar_Inv
 
 QG_INV_3 -->|Pass| TMP2
 QG_INV_3 -.->|Fail| Quar_Inv

 %% 5. STG to TMP: POS SALES PATH
 STG1 --> QG_POS_1
 QG_POS_1 -->|Pass| QG_POS_2
 QG_POS_1 -.->|Fail| Quar_POS
 
 QG_POS_2 -->|Pass| QG_POS_3
 QG_POS_2 -.->|Fail| Quar_POS
 
 QG_POS_3 -->|Pass| QG_POS_4
 QG_POS_3 -.->|Fail| Quar_POS
 
 QG_POS_4 -->|Pass| TMP1
 QG_POS_4 -.->|Fail| Quar_POS

 %% 6. Quarantine Routing (Consolidating to one table)
 Quar_Item -.-> TMP_Q1
 Quar_Store -.-> TMP_Q1
 Quar_Inv -.-> TMP_Q1
 Quar_POS -.-> TMP_Q1
 Quar_Sub -.-> TMP_Q1
 Quar_Dist -.-> TMP_Q1

 %% 6b. SUBCLASS dim path (derived from TMP_ITEM_MASTER, SCD2)
 TMP3 --> QG_SUB_1
 QG_SUB_1 -->|Pass| QG_SUB_2
 QG_SUB_1 -.->|Fail| Quar_Sub
 QG_SUB_2 -->|Pass| QG_SUB_3
 QG_SUB_2 -.->|Fail| Quar_Sub
 QG_SUB_3 -->|Pass| TGT8
 QG_SUB_3 -.->|Fail| Alert_Item

 %% 6c. DISTRICT dim path (derived from TMP_STORE_MASTER, SCD2)
 TMP4 --> QG_DIST_1
 QG_DIST_1 -->|Pass| QG_DIST_2
 QG_DIST_1 -.->|Fail| Quar_Dist
 QG_DIST_2 -->|Pass| QG_DIST_3
 QG_DIST_2 -.->|Fail| Quar_Dist
 QG_DIST_3 -->|Pass| TGT9
 QG_DIST_3 -.->|Fail| Alert_Item

 %% 7. TMP to TGT: Dimensions First
 TMP3 --> TGT1
 TMP4 --> TGT2
 TGT3 -.->|Seed Calendar| TGT5
 TGT3 -.->|Seed Calendar| TGT6
 TGT3 -.->|Seed Calendar| TGT7
 TGT4 -.->|Seed Customer| TGT5

 %% 8. TMP to TGT: Facts (Surrogate Key Joins)
 TMP1 -->|Lookup item_sk, locn_sk, date_sk| TGT5
 TMP2 -->|Lookup item_sk, locn_sk, date_sk| TGT6
 TMP3 -->|Price Attributes| TGT7
 TMP4 -->|Location Attributes| TGT7

 %% 9. Reconciliation & Marts
 TGT5 --> QG6
 TGT6 --> QG6
 TGT7 --> QG6
 QG6 -->|Pass| M1
 QG6 -.->|Fail| Fail2

 %% 10. Auxiliary reference dims → Marts
 TGT8 -.->|Reference dim| M1
 TGT9 -.->|Reference dim| M1

 %% ============================================================
 %% ASSIGN CLASSES
 %% ============================================================
 class S1,S2,S3,S4,S5 source;
 class STG1,STG2,STG3,STG4 stg;
 class TMP1,TMP2,TMP3,TMP4 tmp;
 class TGT1,TGT2,TGT3,TGT4,TGT5,TGT6,TGT7,TGT8,TGT9 tgt;
 class M1 marts;
 class TMP_Q1 quarantine_tbl;
 
 class QG1,QG_ITEM_1,QG_ITEM_2,QG_ITEM_3,QG_STORE_1,QG_STORE_2,QG_STORE_3,QG_SUB_1,QG_SUB_2,QG_SUB_3,QG_DIST_1,QG_DIST_2,QG_DIST_3,QG_INV_1,QG_INV_2,QG_INV_3,QG_POS_1,QG_POS_2,QG_POS_3,QG_POS_4,QG6 decision;
 
 class Fail1,Fail2 fail_action;
 class Quar_Item,Quar_Store,Quar_Inv,Quar_POS,Quar_Sub,Quar_Dist quarantine_action;
 class Alert_Item alert_action;",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
